findings.summary: The contract says the public case id is decimal digits only, while openapi.yaml calls ids opaque, so the contract is tied to the current id format in the code.
The environment name and service version come from operator-set OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES with no character limit, so section 9's claim that every value is fixed is slightly too strong.
The contract gives the ingest server span no attributes, narrower than the criterion, so #290 must not add HTTP attributes without changing the contract first.
In Kiro Web the Tests and Lint steps of make verify cannot run because uv cannot write its Python folder, so CI stood in for them.
Nothing checks yet that the canary block parses as one kind=value line per forbidden kind; #290 or #295 should.
